project: Green Power – 250 MWac solar, Country X
case: SMBC 2024 Analyst Programme – project finance model (bid support for Green Power)
assumptions_log: Energy case P50 for the base case (flip the switch on Inputs to P90; lenders often size on P90).
Land and the upfront fee are paid at financial close (1 Jan 2024); EPC and development costs are spread evenly over 12 months.
Equity is drawn first, then debt; IDC is charged monthly on the opening balance and funded by further debt (part of project cost).
The upfront fee is 1.25% of the final debt amount; debt size and project cost are solved together without circularity (pasted values + checks).
Debt is sculpted to a flat DSCR over the repayment period (first repayment 30 Jun 2025, final maturity 31 Dec 2041).
No tax: the case gives no tax rate (input provided, default 0%).
Depreciation: straight line over 30 years on total project cost excluding land, from completion; no residual value after the PPA.
8,760 hours a year (leap years ignored); O&M escalates 1.5% a year from 2024 prices, tariff flat at USD 80/MWh.

Lender standard added (not in the brief): a DSRA holding the next 2 quarters of senior debt service, funded at COD as part of project cost, topped up / released each quarter and fully released at maturity; no interest on the DSRA balance. Switch it off on Inputs to match the brief exactly.
All other cash after senior debt service and DSRA movements is paid out as dividends each quarter.
Hours per year 8,760 and USD 1,000,000 per USD m are shown as inputs, so no number is typed inside a formula.
case_short: Green Power – 250 MWac solar PF model
